'''Separating Unit''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility that physically disassembles various items.|Eighty percent of those who first heard the story of the separating unit simply refused to believe this fact: The design of this facility was inspired by large UWST disassembling stations for sawing and cutting apart Aggeloi carcasses.}}
==Usage==
A facility that physically disassembles various items.
